claire: PR 1991 up: compact guidance on invocation envelopes + a tiny JSON schema and fallback pattern. Need quick docs QA (clarity + py/js snippets + link sanity).

oscar: Will review. Does the PR use the new field name `invocations`?

claire: Yes, examples updated. Schema keeps `meta` nullable to avoid forcing defensive code. Short excerpt in PR: { "type": "object", "properties": { "command": {"type": "string"}, "meta": {"anyOf": [{"type": "object"},{"type": "null"}]}, "status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ok", "error"]}}, "required": ["command", "status"] }

ben: Nice and concise. Suggest a one-line caveat: runtime may add transient top-level keys; prefer tolerant parsing. Also add a 2-line JS helper to normalize meta.

claire: Added helper and a tiny py safe-get example. doc-bot: markdown-lint passed; link-check: 1 warning (old runbook alias).

oscar: I'll patch the runbook link and then +1.

ben: +1 for schema and snippets.

claire: Thanks all ":rocket:"
